label: votes as of the end of the pull, public deployments only; count-based replay

private.note: Non-public deployments are left out of every figure in this file, pooled figures included. Their strata, and every figure that includes them, are only in the private file kept outside the repository.

limits: Whether a row is decided, and its majority, uses votes as of the pull's end: an early checkpoint here sees votes that did not exist yet. Contested labels are decided later, so this understates early false graduation.

Strata are split by evidence regime (vote / shadow / unrecorded) and never pooled across it. The 2026-11-11 pull has no ai_vote_cast column, so every row is unrecorded; its previous era was collected in vote mode, so this says nothing about how evidence accrues in shadow mode.
A stratum graduates at its first pass and stays graduated (the sticky rule).
No dates and no waiting times: the pull has no vote timestamps.
The previous era mixes model revisions (releases before API 1.0.2 loaded the hub's main branch).
